popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's counsel opposite Hector: Polydamas reads the bird-omen and urges retreat when Hector will not listen — the Trojan voice of caution the war refuses.

popCulture.title: Polydamas (mythology)
popCulture.description: The son of Panthous who shared Hector's birth-night remains the Iliad's wise foil — far the best in speech where Hector was best in the spear.
